descriptions.d26h_jetpack_graphics_init_800ade2c: Loads the Jetpack body and two Jetpack.Afterburn and two Rocket.Flames effects at +32 to +48, hides and rotates the afterburns by pi/2, attaches all four to the body at the two global bones, sets the flame scale at +100, posts the target message with the id at +20, clears six counters, resolves the four jetpack sounds into +84 to +96 and binds the Jetpack.SuperThrustMax property at +112.
